independence_chronology.observations: Previously unused 2022-10-12 JWST/NIRCam F115W photons; this application consumes them. Instrument fields were calibration, not quasar targets. Complete independence of every astrometric/calibration reference is not certified.
independence_chronology.earlier_experiment: Original precision validation remains blocked by failed calibration. This is the separately frozen diagnostic amendment, not a reclassified original success.
independence_chronology.reserved_bands: No reserve band or new native exposure opened by this review.

limits: Every formal covariance and score is conditional on the fixed inadequate instrumental PSF and declared ERR; the astronomical likelihood and centroid bias are not calibrated.

True centroid bias cannot be measured from these observations without an adequate response or independent truth. Raw pixel residuals and exposure disagreement are diagnostics, not an empirically measured physical-bias correction.
The raw G1 improvement is an out-of-fit descriptive comparison of frozen predictions, not precision validation, a unique G1 mass inference, BHSM preference or physical admission.

Exact fit SCI/ERR/DQ values recover from the saved native cutouts and official GWCS maps recover from their serialized archives; complete original117MB CAL byte streams require public native product URLs plus the inherited full-file hashes, not reconstruction from the small cutouts.
